Using Bayes' theorem, we can calculate the probability the taxi is Blue given the witness identifies it as Blue as follows:

P(B|C) = (P(C|B) * P(B)) / (P(C|B) * P(B) + P(C|G) * P(G))

P(B|C) = 0.16 / (0.16 + 0.16)
